text:
maya (support): Hey team — customer AcmeCorp reporting a sudden uptick in 5xx errors from hosted /v1/generate around 20:12 UTC. They say ~15% of requests are returning 502/504 and several streams are timing out. request_id examples: rid=acme-8791, acme-8792.

jordan (cs): Customer put their product on HOLD while this is happening. They're seeing retries from our JS SDK causing extra cost. They asked for an ETA and a temporary mitigation.

maya (support): Repro steps from customer:
1) Use JS SDK v2.1.3, streaming API
2) Send prompt ~2k tokens
3) After ~3s stream, connection resets with 502 or final status 504.
They attached curl header they used: `Authorization: Bearer <token>`, `x-correlation-id: acme-8791`.

liam (eng-oncall): Thanks. I'll look at ingress logs for those correlation ids. @dev-bot can you pull the last 10 mins for acme-* correlation ids in us-west-2?

dev-bot: query started for correlation ids prefix acme- (us-west-2). results: 47 hits in last 12m. Top statuses: 502 (28), 504 (11), 200 (8). Noted increased latency from edge -> runtime for 10s window starting 20:11:30 UTC.

sara (infra): Quick hypothesis: token refresh fanout + nginx keepalive exhaustion at the edge. We're seeing a spike in upstream 502s when connections are recycled. Also a small bump in kernel-level TIME_WAIT count on edge LB.

liam (eng-oncall): On the runtime side I see a cluster of 5xx traces with error msg: `upstream reset while sending request to backend`. Sequence: client -> edge proxy -> authentication service (short-lived) -> runtime. The auth service returned 401 briefly then we got a cascade of resets.

maya (support): Customer claims they did a credential rotation yesterday. Could be related. Jordan, pls ask if they rotated tokens across many hosts simultaneously.

jordan (cs): Confirmed — they did a mass rotation across 40k clients at 19:58 UTC. They also saw a spike in retries from their client lib.

liam (eng-oncall): Ok that fits. Suggestations: 
- immediate mitigation: enable region fallback for them (route to eu-west-1) and have them pause automatic SDK retries for 5xx for 10 minutes.
- infra action: increase edge keepalive pool and add backpressure throttle on auth fanout.

sara (infra): I'll spin a temporary rule to bump max connections on the edge pool and add a short (30s) token refresh jitter. Rolling in 2m.

maya (support): Communicated to customer: we're applying temporary edge adjustments and recommend pausing automatic retries client-side. Asking them to confirm if they can toggle retries.

jordan (cs): Customer toggled retries off. After ~90s they report errors dropped to ~3% and product unpaused in a limited fashion. They're asking for a postmortem and whether we'll credit the excess billing from retries.

liam (eng-oncall): Next steps for us:
- collect logs/traces for acme-8791/8792 etc. (I have trace ids).
- run a repro with token-rerotate script in staging to validate auth fanout handling.
- follow up with permanent fix: implement jitter on token refresh and better circuit breaker at edge.

sara (infra): Deployment note: I pushed the edge keepalive bump and auth jitter patch queued for canary. Monitoring for 10m.

dev-bot: canary deployment status: rollout 25% -> healthy; p95 latency normalized from 420ms -> 190ms on canary nodes.

liam (eng-oncall): Good. I'll prepare a short incident writeup and propose a customer credit (support + billing).

maya (support): Customer update sent: "We've applied edge mitigations which reduced errors significantly. We're continuing root cause work and will share a postmortem and credit details." They replied :thumbsup:.

jordan (cs): Will coordinate billing credit request. Also scheduling an 1:1 with AcmeCorp tomorrow to walk through best practices for token rotation (staggered refresh, backoff).

maya (support): Summary / action items:
- eng: run repro in staging (liam)
- infra: merge auth jitter + keepalive changes (sara)
- support/cs: bill review + customer comms (maya/jordan)
- monitor: keep an eye on acme-* 5xx counts for 24h.

liam (eng-oncall): I'll update this thread when repro completes or if we see regression on canary.

sara (infra): Monitoring shows stable error rate ~2.7% across previously affected keys. I'll keep alerts on.

maya (support): Closing for now as customer is unblocked and product resumed. We'll convert this to a postmortem doc once eng finishes the RCA.

liam (eng-oncall): Thanks all.
